teaser.en: One of the rarest plants of the Shimba Hills, this small forest tree grows almost nowhere else.
teaser.sw: Mmojawapo wa mimea adimu zaidi ya Shimba Hills, mti huu mdogo wa msituni hauoti karibu popote pengine.
teaser.dg: Ni kahi ya mimea adimu zaidi ya Shimba Hills; muhi uhu mdide wa tsaka unaphahikana mara chache sana phatu phanjina.

summary.en: *Msambwe* is a small tree of the lowland rainforest of the southern coastal forests, in the Shimba Hills ecosystem. It has a very restricted range and is counted among the area's threatened plants.
summary.sw: *Msambwe* ni mti mdogo wa msitu wa mvua wa nyanda za chini katika misitu ya kusini ya pwani, ndani ya mfumo wa ikolojia wa Shimba Hills. Eneo lake la kuenea ni finyu sana, na unahesabiwa miongoni mwa mimea iliyo hatarini ya eneo hilo.
summary.dg: *Msambwe* ni muhi mdide wa matsaka ga mvula ga herera, kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ya kusini, ndani ya mazingira ga Shimba Hills. Unaphahikana phatu phachache sana, na ni kahi ya mimea iriyo hatarini ya phatu phapho.

about.en: *Msambwe* is a shrub or small tree of the milkwood family. Its leaves grow in near-whorls, bunched in rings around the stem, and like its relatives it bleeds white latex when cut.
about.sw: *Msambwe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya Sapotaceae. Majani yake huota karibu kwa mizunguko, yakiwa yamejikusanya kama pete kuzunguka shina, na kama jamaa zake, hutoa utomvu mweupe ukikatwa.
about.dg: *Msambwe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya *milkwood*. Makodzage ganakusanyika kpwa mviringo kuzunguluka muhi, phephi kukala dza pete, na dza nduguze, uchikatwa unalavya maziya mereru.

where.en: It grows in lowland rainforest in the southern coastal forests, within the Shimba Hills ecosystem, and is found in very few places.
where.sw: Huota katika msitu wa mvua wa nyanda za chini katika misitu ya kusini ya pwani, ndani ya mfumo wa ikolojia wa Shimba Hills, na unapatikana mahali pachache sana.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga mvula ga herera ga pwani ya kusini, ndani ya mazingira ga Shimba Hills, na unaphahikana phatu phachache sana.

names.en: The Digo name is *msambwe*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Synsepalum subverticillatum*, a name that refers to its almost-whorled leaves.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *msambwe*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Synsepalum subverticillatum*, jina linalorejelea majani yake yanayoota karibu kwa mizunguko.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *msambwe*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Synsepalum subverticillatum*, dzina rinalolavywa kula makodzage ganayomera phephi kukala kpwa mviringo.

conservation.en: *Msambwe* has a restricted range and is listed among four threatened plants of the Shimba Hills ecosystem. Protecting the remaining lowland forest is key to its survival.
conservation.sw: *Msambwe* una eneo finyu la kuenea na umeorodheshwa miongoni mwa mimea minne iliyo hatarini ya mfumo wa ikolojia wa Shimba Hills. Kulinda msitu wa nyanda za chini uliobaki ni muhimu kwa kuendelea kuwepo kwake.
conservation.dg: *Msambwe* unaphahikana phatu phachache, na ukaandikpwa kahi ya mimea mine iriyo hatarini ya mazingira ga Shimba Hills. Kurinda matsaka ga herera garigobaki ni dzambo kulu ili ubaki.

reason.en: Another threatened plant of the Shimba Hills
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine ulio hatarini wa Shimba Hills
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina urio hatarini wa Shimba Hills

reason.en: Another forest member of the milkwood family
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa msituni wa familia ya Sapotaceae
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa tsaka wa jamii ya *milkwood*
